answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 28276 Country: India Title: I want know about parents in islam. if parents is gng 2 wrong way in islam (ex.sharab,zina.and lies etc) can childern stop their parents plz explain islamic way Question: Assalam alai kum I want know about parents in islam. if parents is gng 2 wrong way in islam (ex.sharab,zina.and lies etc) can childern stop their parents plz explain islamic way Answer ID: 28276 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 56/46/H=1432) It is wajib to stop parents with wisdom and prudence i.e. efforts should be made after deep thinking in good manner at best suited time keeping in view their respect and etiquette. However, it would be better for you if you create the situation to make them convinced and advised in privacy by any influential personality. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
